title: Computer lab with multiple desktops, whiteboard and a standing presenter
objects_and_counts: At least six people are visible and individually distinguishable: one person standing at the right edge of the image, and at least five seated or partially seated at desks toward the centre and left of the room.

At least seven standalone computer monitors are individually visible in the photographed scene (one large monitor in the foreground, several monitors in rows behind it and at least one at the right-rear).
At least five desktop PC towers with visible lit internal lighting (blue/green LEDs) are individually visible; several towers are positioned next to or behind monitors.
One full-size keyboard is visible on the foreground desk directly behind the large monitor.
One tall reusable water bottle is visible on the foreground desk at the left front of the image.
One backpack is visible on the floor near the person standing at the right.
One large wall-mounted whiteboard spans the rear wall of the room and is visible behind the seated people.
At least one power strip or electrical outlet extension is visible on the floor under/near the foreground desk, and multiple cables are visible around desk legs and computer towers.
Several office chairs are present and in use by seated people; individual chair count cannot be precisely determined from the image due to occlusion.

Desktop PC towers with blue/green internal lighting are positioned beside or behind monitors in the middle and left regions of the room.
The person who is standing is on the right side of the image near the whiteboard and faces roughly toward the room interior; a backpack is on the floor near their feet.
Ceiling light panels occupy the upper portion of the image; the camera viewpoint is from slightly above and angled down, capturing most of the room from front to rear.
